chunks: And (remember) Abraham, when he said to his people: 'Worship God and be conscious of Him. That is better for you, if you only knew.'

key_terms.اتَّقُوهُ: Be conscious of Him / Fear Him

ai.seo_question: What did Abraham tell his people about worship and God-consciousness?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight Ibrahim’s role as the archetype of pure monotheism (Tawhid al-Mufrad), distinguishing true worship from mere ritualism. It underscores the intellectual dimension of faith, where Taqwa is not just fear but a conscious recognition of God’s oneness, a theme central to the Imams' teachings on the unity of knowledge and action.
